author: FalsePositives
quote: There are a lot of fake positive reviews from people who obviously haven't played the game. This "game" isn't much ****. It feels like a data collection platform to help train world building AI. The kind of data that fills in how humans get to an outcome. It plays like a choice simulator and not like a GTA game. It's a lot like a censored GTA 5 with a extremely boring story, unlikeable characters, and not a shred of humor. The other GTAs are loaded with satire and humor. 6 has absolutely none. I requested my refund. Save yourself the trouble and don't buy.
